role: RecoveryScoreCalculator composite entry points (calculate overloads delegating to calculateWithBreakdown) and the display helpers displayScore/toTenScale.
types: RecoveryScoreCalculator: extension — composite score + display helpers

units.does: Composite recovery score from calculateWithBreakdown(trainingMetrics:) clamped 0..100, non-finite → 0.

flags.text: No caller in app or tests uses the trainingMetrics: overload; the only RecoveryScoreCalculator.calculate call (MorningResultsViewModel.swift:178) uses trainingContext:.

units.does: Composite recovery score from calculateWithBreakdown(trainingContext:) clamped 0..100, non-finite → 0. Called by MorningResultsViewModel.liveRecoveryScore.

flags.text: A non-finite composite displays as 0 (worst score) rather than as missing; the comment says this backstop 'should never fire'.

units.does: Raw 0-100 score → rounded clamped Int, non-finite → 0. Used by score views, PDF/assistant facts.

flags.text: displayScore says it 'must stay the ONE place the raw→display clamp lives', but ScoreVerdict.clampedDisplayScore/safeDisplayScore do the same clamp and round, make the same 'ONE place' claim, and are used at about 21 sites. DeterministicIntent still renders factor scores with a raw Int(factor.score.rounded()), which traps on a non-finite value.

units.does: Divides a 0-100 score by 10 for storage in session.recoveryScore (no clamp).
